info.title: Giant Gorg
info.synopsis: Il giovane Yū Tagami si reca sull'Isola Australe, emersa dal mare dieci anni prima (ma senza essere segnata nelle cartine geografiche), cercando di indagare sulla morte del padre, un professore che stava studiando questa nuova terra inesplorata e che è rimasto ucciso in circostanze misteriose. Nell'effettuare le sue ricerche Yū scoprirà che nell'isola si trovano manufatti misteriosi, mostri meccanici, alieni e robot giganti. Il giovane suo malgrado si troverà in una situazione più grande di lui e dovrà combattere contro un'organizzazione criminale nota come GAIL.

episodes.title: Again, Towards the Mountain of Fire

info.title: The Warrior Princess and the Barbaric King
info.synopsis: Durante una feroce battaglia la guerriera più forte dell'intero occidente, Seraphina de Lavillant viene catturata e resa prigioniera dai barbari orientali. Convinta di doversi sottoporre a infinte torture prega di venire uccisa, ma le viene offerto un matrimonio con il re del loro popolo.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Serafina, a knight from the Illdoren Kingdom fighting in an eastern expedition, meets her match.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Veor shows Serafina a small part of his life, leading to no small bit of culture shock.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Veor intends on introducing Sera to more of the tribe, but the cultural exchange is suddenly interrupted.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Sera is introduced to the chiefs of the other tribes, who are not what she expected.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: A party headed by a retinue priest from the eastern expedition shows up, looking to "rescue" Sera.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Sera works with Veor and the barbarians to overcome the Fiend, before having an unexpected reunion.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Sera and Malcius witness the ritual to undo the damage caused by the Fiend.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: After her engagement necklace comes off, Sera tries to find a way to put back on.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: With Sera feeling conflicted, Veor offers a suggestion to help her gain perspective.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Sera and her group arrive at the Quefto city of Furnace Ridge.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Sera learns the incredible inspiration behind the Quefto's curiosity.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Sera and Veor, with a cohort of Quefto, do battle against the fearsome Guren Nairi!

info.title: Muteking (ITA)
info.synopsis: Il protagonista della storia è Linn, un ragazzino americano di dodici anni che, nei panni dell'eroe Muteking, collabora con Takoro. Quest'ultimo è una sorta di polipo rosa alieno che si trova a San Francisco per catturare la famigerata banda della piovra, formato appunto da 4 piovre provenienti dal suo pianeta natale.

episodes.title: Uno strano aiuto sceriffo
episodes.synopsis: Rin Yuki meets Takoro, who helps him transform into the superhero Muteking to battle the Kurodako Brothers.

episodes.title: Operazione maniglia
episodes.synopsis: Muteking deals with chaos caused by a mysterious strap-based alien technology​.

episodes.title: Mangia e rimangia
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers create robotic chairs that force-feed people until they are too full to move. Muteking steps in to stop this strange, food-related alien scheme.

episodes.title: Il falso terremoto
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers attempt to conquer Earth through spreading disinformation, and Muteking has to counter their misinformation​.

episodes.title: Tutti al mare
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers cause a great flood by manipulating waves, and Muteking must find a way to stop the disaster.

episodes.title: L'astrologia colpisce ancora
episodes.synopsis: Muteking finds himself dealing with strange personal consultations brought on by the Kurodako Brothers’ newest plan​.

episodes.title: La diabolica operazione baseball
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers disrupt a baseball game with their antics, leading to an unusual match where Muteking must intervene​.

episodes.title: Panico nella giungla
episodes.synopsis: The jungle is in chaos, and Muteking has to handle the mess caused by alien interference.

episodes.title: Operazione divertimento
episodes.synopsis: Muteking leads a playful adventure where everyone is involved in a big game orchestrated by the Kurodako Brothers.

episodes.title: L'allineamento catastrofico
episodes.synopsis: Muteking confronts a new threat in the form of an octopus that is revealed to be a powerful force from space.

episodes.title: Il pericolo tecnologico
episodes.synopsis: Muteking encounters an invasion of robots sent by the Kurodako Brothers, adding a mechanical twist to their usual alien plots.

episodes.title: Un castello affollato
episodes.synopsis: A ghostly figure appears in the Kurodako Mansion, and Muteking must investigate and stop any paranormal threats the Kurodako Brothers may be using.

episodes.title: La caccia al tesoro
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers embark on a treasure hunt, and Muteking tries to prevent them from uncovering dangerous items or power sources.

episodes.title: L'amore è più forte
episodes.synopsis: A new hero enters the scene—a female version of Muteking, adding a twist to the familiar storyline and challenging the Kurodako Brothers in unexpected ways.

episodes.title: Il letargo
episodes.synopsis: In a winter-themed episode, the Kurodako Brothers try to freeze the city, forcing Muteking to intervene amid snowy chaos.

episodes.title: La pioggia letale
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers’ latest scheme claims humans will evaporate in rain, a strange and unique plot Muteking must expose.

episodes.title: La pigrizia è una brutta cosa
episodes.synopsis: This comedic episode explores the Kurodako Brothers' latest gimmick, involving people enjoying themselves in cars with unexpected results.

episodes.title: Balla che ti passa
episodes.synopsis: In a celebratory setting, Muteking takes on the Kurodako Brothers during a festival, where dancing becomes key to thwarting their plans.

episodes.title: Il casco del perfetto secchione
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers develop a helmet they claim is perfect for mind control, and Muteking must stop them from controlling people’s minds.

episodes.title: La musica popolare
episodes.synopsis: Music returns as a theme with the Kurodako Brothers unleashing their new soundwave technology, which Muteking must counter.

episodes.title: Il circo degli inganni
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers set up a circus to draw crowds, where they plan to trap and brainwash attendees. Muteking must disrupt their act and save the audience.

episodes.title: La giungla d'asfalto
episodes.synopsis: In this episode, the Kurodako Brothers create a vast, confusing maze, trapping people inside. Muteking takes on the challenge of navigating it to rescue the captives.

episodes.title: La pietra della felicità
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers claim to have a lucky stone that grants immense power. Muteking intervenes before they can use it to control people’s minds.

episodes.title: La maratona
episodes.synopsis: Takoro, Muteking’s alien friend, joins a marathon race where the Kurodako Brothers use dirty tricks to sabotage the competition, but Muteking steps in to ensure a fair race.

episodes.title: Takoro e le arti marziali
episodes.synopsis: In a mountainous region, Muteking confronts the Kurodako Brothers in a high-stakes showdown, testing his abilities against their latest strategies.

episodes.title: Una questione di macchine
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers create a “Hot Saucer” attraction that hypnotizes people. Muteking must find a way to break the spell and stop their sinister scheme.

episodes.title: Il paradiso terrestre
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers try to establish their version of a utopia on Earth. Muteking works to reveal their true intentions and dismantle their plans.

episodes.title: Pic-nic con sorpresa
episodes.synopsis: In an underwater adventure, Muteking discovers the Kurodako Brothers’ “Ryugu Castle,” where they plan to unleash a flood. He must stop them to prevent widespread destruction.

episodes.title: Il viaggio spaziale
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers aim to extend their reach to the moon, planning a lunar conquest that Muteking must thwart in a cosmic battle.

episodes.title: La madre di Michi
episodes.synopsis: This episode takes a more heartfelt turn as Muteking faces a personal challenge involving his friend Mitchie, bringing a touch of emotion to the series.

episodes.title: Tokomi ci prova
episodes.synopsis: Takomi, a character with a heartfelt storyline, experiences a story of unrequited love, adding a more emotional element to the series.

episodes.title: La delegazione spaziale
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers face an unexpected failure in their latest scheme, which leads to a humorous exploration of their reactions to defeat.

episodes.title: Trasloco
episodes.synopsis: In a Japan-focused episode, Muteking and his friends embark on a journey, facing cultural clashes and new challenges brought by the Kurodako Brothers.

episodes.title: La vergogna di arrivare ultimi
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers set up a big race event, where they attempt to interfere with the competition, prompting Muteking to jump into the race to save the day.

episodes.title: Pascoli selvaggi
episodes.synopsis: Set on a ranch, Muteking must confront the Kurodako Brothers in a dangerous showdown involving a series of physical challenges.

episodes.title: Camion
episodes.synopsis: This episode introduces a villain who uses a haunted truck to terrorize the streets. Muteking faces a high-speed, horror-themed challenge to stop him.

episodes.title: Takoro si arruola
episodes.synopsis: Takoro, Muteking's alien friend, takes on a pseudo-police role in a comedic fashion, attempting to uphold justice amid the Kurodako Brothers’ antics.

episodes.title: Piccolo Takoro cresce
episodes.synopsis: Takoro’s mother makes an appearance, bringing family dynamics into play as Takoro faces both familial expectations and the ongoing alien threats.

episodes.title: Una gita in barca
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers organize a boat tour with the intention of scamming tourists, and Muteking intervenes to prevent their fraudulent scheme.

episodes.title: La corsa delle lettighe
episodes.synopsis: During a local festival involving portable shrines, Muteking finds himself in the middle of a chaotic melee, battling against the Kurodako Brothers in a unique setting.

episodes.title: La corsa
episodes.synopsis: The episode features a hot-air balloon race orchestrated by the Kurodako Brothers. Muteking joins in to prevent their scheme from taking a chaotic turn.

episodes.title: I fumetti di Takoro
episodes.synopsis: Takoro decides to entertain the public with a storytelling performance, but the Kurodako Brothers have plans to turn it into a mess, and Muteking has to step in to keep order.

episodes.title: Un furto esplosivo
episodes.synopsis: In a festival of fireworks, the Kurodako Brothers attempt to control the display to create chaos in the city. Muteking must stop them before the fireworks endanger the spectators.

episodes.title: Speculazione edilizia
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers hold a "great sale" event at their mansion, luring in customers with sinister intentions. Muteking investigates to uncover their plan.

episodes.title: Un treno in... pensione
episodes.synopsis: A beloved train is set to retire, but the Kurodako Brothers plot to exploit the event. Muteking gets involved to prevent them from ruining the occasion.

episodes.title: Il mostro dello stagno
episodes.synopsis: In a beach-themed episode, the Kurodako Brothers disrupt a summer vacation spot, and Muteking must restore peace to keep everyone safe.

episodes.title: La pesca
episodes.synopsis: Takoro goes on a fishing trip that the Kurodako Brothers plan to sabotage. Muteking joins in to ensure Takoro’s safety and to foil their plans.

episodes.title: Il mantello magico
episodes.synopsis: A panda goes missing, and the Kurodako Brothers use an invisibility cloak in their latest scheme. Muteking embarks on a search to reveal the panda’s location.

episodes.title: Siamo tutti artisti
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers target a local theater, attempting to ruin a play by cutting the lights. Muteking intervenes to save the performance.

episodes.title: La fidanzata di papà
episodes.synopsis: This episode shows a softer side to the Kurodako Brothers, as they explore family themes. Muteking finds himself in an unexpected situation that reveals more about his foes.

episodes.title: Il giro delle 34 porte
episodes.synopsis: Takosak experiences his first love, creating a comedic and emotional episode that explores feelings and unexpected challenges in romance.

episodes.title: Luna amica
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers, known for their villainy, signal for help, revealing a more vulnerable side as they face an unforeseen dilemma that requires Muteking’s intervention.

episodes.title: Videogiochi
episodes.synopsis: In a game-like scenario, the Kurodako Brothers set up challenges for Muteking. This episode dives into strategy and highlights Muteking's clever tactics against the brothers’ tricky games.

episodes.title: La squadra di soccorso
episodes.synopsis: Muteking faces off against a Kurodako-created rescue squad, leading to a series of intense and humorous confrontations as he works to dismantle their latest plans.

episodes.title: La quarta dimensione
episodes.synopsis: The Kurodako Brothers utilize a teleportation device to evade capture, leading Muteking on a thrilling chase filled with teleportation-induced chaos.

episodes.title: L'avventura finisce?
episodes.synopsis: In this series finale, Muteking engages in a final showdown with the Kurodako Brothers. The stakes are high as the characters confront their biggest conflict, bringing closure to the series with a climactic battle.

info.title: Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway: The Sorcery of Nymph Circe
info.synopsis: Secondo film della trilogia di Hathaway che celebra il 40° anniversario del franchise di Gundam, e il secondo progetto nel "UC NexT 0100 Project" che affronterà il futuro della timeline dell'UC.

info.title: Paw & Palaces
info.synopsis: All'insaputa dei turisti che affollano la Città Proibita, sei gatti speciali compongono la "Guardia Imperiale dei Gatti", un'organizzazione segreta creata per proteggere i tesori nazionali. Di notte, la squadra entra nel Wuhua, la dimensione spirituale custodita nei reperti d'epoca, per difenderne le memorie storiche dalla malvagia entità demoniaca Black Owl. Tra scontri per ripristinare il corretto corso del passato, litigi e momenti di unione, i felini lottano per salvaguardare il patrimonio culturale dell'umanità.
